text:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout ref=release/optimize-hpa -> cluster=prod, step=canary(1/10)  

emma-oncall: Seeing 5xx spike on /v1/generate from canary pods. Raising pager :rotating_light:  

sre-jordan: tailing logs on model-encoder-canary-0, crashlooping. snippet:
```
RuntimeError: KV cache size mismatch
  at encoder/init.py:243
  at serve.loop
```

eng-lead-amy: What changed in this manifest? HPA or resources?  

emma-oncall: Diff shows HPA targetCPUPercent 60 -> 20 and resources.requests.memory changed from "256Mi" -> "25Mi" (looks like a missing 0). probable cause for OOM/crashloops.  

support-luis: Customer BigRetailer reporting latency/502s from EU region, ~2% traffic affected. They just opened a support ticket.  

sre-jordan: Initiating immediate rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-encoder --to-revision=42` and removing canary weight.  

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered, pausing staged rollout and preventing further promotions. Canary traffic -> 0.  

infra-bot: Applying temporary feature-flag kill: `features.model_encoder_staging=false` to short-circuit staging path.  

eng-lead-amy: Confirming: killing flag should route traffic back to stable encoder. If stable path healthy, proceed with full rollback and rollback release notes.  

emma-oncall: After rollback + flag kill, 5xx rate dropped to baseline within ~90s. Monitoring shows errors reduced and customer errors falling. Creating incident INC-20260317.  

support-luis: Notified BigRetailer that we're rolling back and applying mitigations; they'll monitor on their side. They asked for ETA on full fix.  

sre-jordan: Next actions: (1) fix manifest typo (resource.requests.memory), (2) add HPA validation in CI, (3) create small canary memory smoke test.  

eng-lead-amy: Assigned follow-ups: amy -> manifest patch & release, jordan -> CI checks, emma -> postmortem draft, luis -> customer follow-up.  

emma-oncall: Handing off monitoring to day oncall @sre-maya. I'm off for the rest of the shift at 09:15 UTC.  
sre-maya: Ack, will watch metrics for 2h and join postmortem.  

(reacted :thumbsup: by eng-lead-amy)
